annotator: Codex visual inspection; no independent human review
annotation_method: Reviewed each entire window at 1 Hz, then 4 Hz contact sheets for brief events, repeated shots and boundaries. Inspected targeted boundary montages. No benchmark CLIP scores were available. A CPU smoke test used excluded source times 100s and 110s. Boundaries are grid-aligned with approximately 0.25s uncertainty; fades/morphs are ambiguous. Not publication-grade ground truth.

sintel_00.text: An older man with a gray beard and a headband indoors.
sintel_00.rationale: The sole close shot of the older bearded character; fade-in included once visible.
sintel_00.confounders: Dark fade-in; other human faces; animation domain.

sintel_00.text: A red-haired woman surrounded by burning rubble.
sintel_00.rationale: Woman against visible fire and debris, distinct from warm sunset shots.
sintel_00.confounders: Other shots of the same woman in orange light; dim first frame.

sintel_00.text: A narrow stone alley viewed from above.
sintel_00.rationale: Single overhead alley shot, including visible portions of fades.
sintel_00.confounders: Rooftop/city shots later; low illumination at boundaries.

sintel_00.text: Golden sand dunes stretching into the distance.
sintel_00.rationale: Desert landscape through the end fade; title overlay does not remove the landscape.
sintel_00.confounders: Dissolve from dragon shot; title and fade at end.

steel_20.text: Two people with bicycles standing beside canal railings.
steel_20.rationale: Continuous bridge conversation; bicycles visible under the people.
steel_20.confounders: People gesture and partially occlude bicycles; long event.

steel_20.text: A hand adjusting knobs on an electronic control panel.
steel_20.rationale: Only close-up of hands operating physical knobs in this window.
steel_20.confounders: Many holographic interfaces also look like control panels.

steel_20.text: A human brain on a plate with wires attached.
steel_20.rationale: Brain remains visible after the camera reveals a man behind it.
steel_20.confounders: Prop brain, camera reframing, foreground wiring.

steel_20.text: Bright green and pink holographic playback controls.
steel_20.rationale: Close view of horizontal virtual playback bars before the physical controls cut.
steel_20.confounders: Similar colorful overlays recur over people; specific playback-bar layout is the event.

steel_140.text: A close view of a man holding a scoped rifle behind white stone columns.
steel_140.rationale: All close rifle shots, including drinking during the middle shot; the tiny background rifleman at 3.5–6s is outside the close-view query.
steel_140.confounders: Repeated shots, different angles, rifle partly occluded by balustrade.

steel_140.text: A coil of rope lying on a dark stone floor.
steel_140.rationale: Low camera view shows the rope coil before tilting up away from the floor.
steel_140.confounders: Other hanging ropes; camera tilt gradually removes the coil.

steel_140.text: A wide symmetrical view of a tall arched window in a ruined hall.
steel_140.rationale: The full tall window is centered in this distinct wide shot.
steel_140.confounders: Window fragments and ruined architecture occur in other shots.

steel_140.text: An ivy-covered brick doorway opening into a warmly lit room.
steel_140.rationale: Exterior wide shot frames the open warm room; reverse view begins at 49.5s.
steel_140.confounders: Warm interior shots share colors; reverse courtyard view also contains brickwork.

steel_260.text: A hand pressing a bright green playback button.
steel_260.rationale: Single physical green button close-up; no requirement to read the label.
steel_260.confounders: Related green virtual controls elsewhere; motion blur.

steel_260.text: A close-up of a short-haired woman outdoors with trees behind her.
steel_260.rationale: Woman's face is fully visible after the robot morph; later reverse shot only shows the back of her head.
steel_260.confounders: Morphing boundary and subsequent partial occlusion; exclude the earlier nonhuman head.

steel_260.text: A close-up of a box-shaped robot head with round glowing eyes.
steel_260.rationale: Both frontal close robot-head shots, including the visible head during the second morph.
steel_260.confounders: Robot also appears in wide shots; transitional geometry near 49.5s.

steel_260.text: A man wearing glasses surrounded by colorful holographic screens.
steel_260.rationale: Both views of the bespectacled technician; back-of-head-only control view is excluded.
steel_260.confounders: Other men have monocle-like machinery; similar screen colors recur without a frontal face.

steel_380.text: A close-up of a dark-haired man with a robotic hand covering his mouth.
steel_380.rationale: All four close views of the man's face and mechanical hand; reverse/wide shots excluded by close-up wording.
steel_380.confounders: Repeated appearances, woman and cropped edge of man in reverse shots, text overlay.

steel_380.text: A blue wireframe figure beside a man outdoors.
steel_380.rationale: Visible wireframe transition before the fully solid large robot.
steel_380.confounders: Brief synthetic visual effect; earlier small face flicker is not a whole figure.

steel_380.text: A huge robot gripping a man's shoulders beside trees.
steel_380.rationale: Solid large robot with hand around the man's shoulder area; stops at technician cut.
steel_380.confounders: Previous human-sized robotic hand, wireframe transition, cluttered metal body.

steel_380.text: A soldier with a backpack holding a rifle at a balcony.
steel_380.rationale: Back and wide views of the armed figure on the balcony; floor-level close shot starts at 57.25s.
steel_380.confounders: Rapid movement and partial occlusion by ropes/columns; later same soldier on floor.

steel_500.text: A soldier holding a rope beneath wooden beams.
steel_500.rationale: Brief visible soldier and rope, before the lab cut.
steel_500.confounders: Motion blur, rifle and rope overlap, short event without precursor in coarse sample.

steel_500.text: Bright circular lights on machinery in a dark interior.
steel_500.rationale: Large bright circular lights before they visibly extinguish; later faint pinpoints are not the same bright state.
steel_500.confounders: Gradual extinguishing; detailed dark machinery remains after lights go out.

steel_500.text: Large rusty orange pipes inside an industrial hall.
steel_500.rationale: Entire orange-pipe shot across camera motion and moving machinery.
steel_500.confounders: Robot passes behind pipes; earlier window shot shares warm light.

steel_500.text: An older gray-haired man face-to-face with a large robot.
steel_500.rationale: Both sequences show the older man beside the robot, including close face view with robot foreground.
steel_500.confounders: Repeated view and scale changes; robot partially cropped in facial close-ups.
